body.name: Weighted elimination projection coefficient
body.construction: For every possible best arm \(h\), set \(d_{h j}=\sqrt{2(v_h+v_j)}\), \(F_h(t)=t^2/(2v_h)+\sum_{j\ne h}(d_{h j}-t)_+^2/(2v_j)\), \(C_h(v)=\min_{t\ge0}F_h(t)\), and \(C(v)=\min_h C_h(v)\). Compute each \(C_h\) by sorting the \(K-1\) breakpoints \(d_{h j}\), evaluating the clipped stationary point \(t_A=\{\sum_{j\in A}d_{h j}/v_j\}/\{1/v_h+\sum_{j\in A}1/v_j\}\) on each induced interval, and taking the smallest value.
